The source is a compact four-signal teaching sequence—stopping, eye contact, continued conversation and acceptance of a romantic frame—intercut with multiple public approach examples. Formal sources contain related propositions, but the reviewed sources do not reproduce this complete ordered package or edited field sequence.
All 10 sampled frames were reviewed. They alternate a single-host sofa monologue with several public street interactions and a branded outro.

boundary: New means no whole-source duplicate was found in the formal 202-source index. The eye-contact, romantic-frame and stop-on-withdrawal ideas overlap existing themes and add no automatic independent truth, safety or runtime permission.
